Content: Also there are a number of circuits which have been taped out on Tiny Tapeout;  the ones on GF180MCU support some analog design tiles.  Go to https://tinytapeout.com/chips;  all chip entries starting with `TTGF` were done on GF180MCU.  The designs may or may not be useful because they are not curated.  You can cross-check against the list of "silicon validated" designs, but for Tiny Tapeout, "validation" means "it worked", not that it has (or hit) any particular specification.
